generations.prompt: Close-up, looking straight down at black, wet, oily mud in a square sondage at the bottom of a deep excavation trench at dusk. A blue nitrile-gloved hand scrapes the mud with a small pointed steel trowel. The trowel strikes something hard under the mud and stops dead. The hand pauses, then scrapes again in the same place and exposes a small patch of flat, smooth grey stone under the black mud. Camera is fixed, looking down, no camera movement. Audio: a trowel scraping wet mud, then a sharp ring when the steel strikes stone, then scraping again. No music, no speech. No on-screen text, no captions, no watermark.
